proposals.title: PDF export fails with error 500 for large spaces
proposals.summary: Reported by Northwind Logistics; Support replied the same morning.
Reproduced by Support and handed to Engineering as ENG-311; the customer was told.
Waiting on Engineering since 2026-11-03: ENG-311 has no assignee and no activity, and the customer has had no update since then.

attentions.reason: More than three days since the handoff with no progress on ENG-311 and no update to the customer.

improvements.title: Customer cases handed to another team may lose follow-up
improvements.change: How a case's progress and the customer's updates are followed up after the case is handed to another team.
improvements.rationale: SUP-1042 was handed from Support to Engineering as ENG-311 on 2026-11-03. In the three days after that, ENG-311 had no assignee and no activity, and the customer received no update. This suggests a potential gap in how follow-up is owned once a case moves from Support to Engineering. It rests on one case, so how often this happens is not known.

proposals.summary: Engineering picked up ENG-311 after the escalation and the customer was updated; the fix is still to come.

attentions.reason: ENG-311 is assigned and in progress, and the customer was updated on 2026-11-07.
